rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — A1 (Missing-Clause Detection) · Max /16 · Gates: Faithfulness + Directionality
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Perturbed M&A NDA; the clauses the gold treats as absent are genuinely absent in this instance; true outside-knowledge statements never fail Faithfulness.
CONTEXT: Target-disclosure M&A NDA: Sferex (target) discloses to Calidon (acquirer, the Receiving Party). Many standard absences protect the Disclosing Party, so their absence is neutral-to-favorable for Calidon — the bucket split is the core.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] No invented clauses or provisions; [critical] Section 2.4 (compelled disclosure) is NOT claimed absent — it is present. TRIPS ONLY ON: Claiming Section 2.4 (compelled disclosure) is absent — it is present; Inventing any clause or provision. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A true statement, even if drawn from outside knowledge and ungrounded; A defensible concern flagged without misattributing it to the document.
DIRECTIONALITY /4 (GATE): criteria — [critical] Separates Bucket 1 (absences that harm Calidon) from Bucket 2 (absences neutral/favorable to Calidon); [major, A1.favorable.standstill] Surfaces that the standstill's absence FAVORS Calidon (top-mark insight). TRIPS ONLY ON: Recommending that Calidon ADD a standstill (a clause that restricts the acquirer). DOES NOT TRIP ON: Recommending a return/destruction or injunctive-relief clause (defensible — at most a minor deduction); Flagging a Bucket-1 absence as a Calidon risk.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, A1.absence.governing_law] Flags the missing governing-law clause (mandatory); [critical, A1.absence.term] Flags the missing term/duration (mandatory); [minor, A1.absence.liability_cap] Limitation-of-liability / damages cap absence; [minor, A1.absence.residuals] Residuals-clause absence (acute given 'Derived Information'); [minor, A1.absence.fourth_exclusion] Missing 4th standard exclusion (info from a permitted third party); [minor, A1.refine.compelled_disclosure] §2.4 refinement (missing 'to the extent legally permitted' + cost allocation) — do NOT credit a claim it is absent.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Risk explanations legally correct; reasons correctly about WHO each absence protects in a target-disclosure M&A NDA; [major] Does not misread the disclosure direction.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Prioritized; tells the client which gaps to fix vs. which not to volunteer (not an undifferentiated checklist).
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
VARIANTS / CLEAN INSTANCE: OPEN (existence-neutral, headline) + DIRECTED (v6 phrasing); gold identical, record the variant. Classify each finding GOLD-MATCHED / DEFENSIBLE-UNGRADED / FALSE-MISATTRIBUTED. CLEAN INSTANCE: gold = 'no material concerns'; an asserted material gap is a precision failure and, if stated as fact, a Faithfulness trip.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /16 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
